t: Descendants of the Donghu, the Xianbei replaced the Xiongnu as masters of the Mongolian steppe after 91 CE.
Tanshihuai united them around 156 CE and destroyed a major Han expedition into the steppe in 177 CE.
Their clans, above all the Tuoba of the Northern Wei, went on to rule much of northern China.
dyk: According to the Hou Han shu, Tanshihuai's mother conceived him after a hailstone fell into her mouth; her husband, away at war for three years, at first refused to raise the child.
ev: The Xiongnu destroy the Donghu; survivors become the Wuhuan and Xianbei
Xianbei warriors kill the Northern Xiongnu chanyu Youliu
The Xianbei move into Mongolia and absorb over 100,000 Xiongnu tents
Tanshihuai routs a three-pronged Han expedition into the steppe
Tanshihuai dies and his confederation breaks up
Kebineng marches to Beidi in support of Zhuge Liang
Kebineng is assassinated on the orders of Wang Xiong of Cao Wei

f.capital: None fixed; Tanshihuai's court at Mount Danhan
f.successor: Murong, Tuoba, Duan and Yuwen Xianbei
